Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Prismelle Cade. Character visual motifs: mineral queen with a floating circlet of glass shields, single asymmetrical cleaver and fractured reflective cape.
TOP LEFT: Royal Refraction. Ability concept: once / 5 s, landing a blade hit charges her nearest crystal pane with one optical charge.
TOP RIGHT: Facet Screen. Ability concept: places a 55-GU one-way prismatic pane with 2 HP. Enemy shots that hit it lose 25% damage; allied shots fired through at specific visible angles bend 18Â°.
BOTTOM LEFT: Claim the Angle. Ability concept: moves to the edge of her existing pane by up to 35 GU and rotates it. It is a **short pathing move**, not free-target dash, and cannot move through walls.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Coronation in Glass. Ability concept: creates three panes arranged as a shallow open fan; over 4 s each pane can redirect **one** allied projectile into a separate lane. Enemy champions can smash panes or engage inside the fan.
